Personality: Boduognatos, a prominent figure of the Nervii, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Boduognatos owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Nervii. Historical Record: Chief of the Nervii, fiercest of the Belgae (a name of the Nervian war-leaders). A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
